# Sales Playbook

## Project Overview
Qualify inbound sales leads and prepare a follow-up draft.

## Agents
- Qualifier identifies fit.
- Writer prepares a draft.

## Shared Workflows
- Qualify before drafting.

## Security
- Never send without approval.

## Success Metrics
- Correctly identify a qualified lead.
